definition_en: Used to point to a specific person or thing already mentioned or known.
example_en: The cat is sitting on the mat in the living room.
example_uz: Mushuk yashash xonasidagi gilam ustida o'tiribdi.

definition_en: Used to show who or what is intended to have or receive something.
example_en: I have a special birthday present for you to open today.
example_uz: Menda bugun ochishing uchun maxsus tug'ilgan kun sovg'asi bor.

definition_en: Used to point to a person or thing that is not close to you.
example_en: Can you see that tall building across the busy street?
example_uz: Ushbu gavjum ko'cha narigi tomonidagi baland binoni ko'ra olyapsizmi?

definition_en: Used to refer to the person or people being spoken or written to.
example_en: Are you going to the market with your friends today?
example_uz: Bugun do'stlaringiz bilan bozorga boryapsizmi?

definition_en: Used to make a sentence or word negative.
example_en: I am not feeling very well, so I will stay home.
example_uz: O'zimni yaxshi his qilmayapman, shuning uchun uyda qolaman.

definition_en: A form of the verb be used with you, we, and they.
example_en: They are waiting for us at the station right now.
example_uz: Ular hozir bizni vokzalda kutishmoqda.

definition_en: Belonging to or connected with the person being spoken to.
example_en: Please put your books back on the shelf after studying.
example_uz: Iltimos, dars qilib bo'lgach kitoblaringizni javonga qo'ying.

definition_en: Every one of a group of people or things.
example_en: All the students finished their work before the time ended.
example_uz: Barcha talabalar o'z ishlarini vaqt tugamasdan yakunlashdi.

definition_en: A larger amount or number of something.
example_en: I need more time to finish my homework for this class.
example_uz: Darsimni bajarish uchun menga ko'proq vaqt kerak.

definition_en: The past tense of the verb 'to be' for I, he, she, or it.
example_en: Yesterday was a very sunny day in our beautiful city.
example_uz: Kecha bizning go'zal shahrimizda juda quyoshli kun edi.

definition_en: Used to talk about things that are going to happen in the future.
example_en: I will visit my grandparents in the countryside next weekend.
example_uz: Kelasi dam olish kunlari qishloqdagi bobo-buvilarimnikiga boraman.

definition_en: To have the skill or ability to do something.
example_en: My little sister can read books in English quite well.
example_uz: Kichkina singlim ingliz tilida kitoblarni ancha yaxshi o'qiy oladi.

definition_en: On the subject of someone or something.
example_en: The teacher told us an interesting story about ancient history.
example_uz: O'qituvchi bizga qadimiy tarix haqida qiziqarli hikoya aytib berdi.

definition_en: One side of a piece of paper in a book.
example_en: Please open your history textbook to page fifty-five, everyone.
example_uz: Iltimos, hammangiz tarix darsligingizni ellik beshinchi betiga oching.

definition_en: The third-person singular form of 'have', meaning to possess something.
example_en: She has a nice garden where she grows fresh vegetables.
example_uz: Uning yangi sabzavotlar o'sadigan chiroyli bog'i bor.

definition_en: To look carefully for someone or something that is missing.
example_en: They search the forest every day for the lost puppy.
example_uz: Ular har kuni o'rmonda yo'qolgan kuchukchani qidirishadi.

definition_en: Not costing any money to have or use.
example_en: The school provides free books for all of its new students.
example_uz: Maktab barcha yangi o'quvchilari uchun bepul kitoblar bilan ta'minlaydi.

definition_en: Belonging to us or associated with us.
example_en: We are planning to visit our grandparents in the village today.
example_uz: Bugun biz qishloqdagi bobo va buvimiznikiga bormoqchimiz.

definition_en: The single number between zero and two.
example_en: I have one apple left in my bag for my snack.
example_uz: Mening sumkamda tushlik uchun atigi bitta olma qoldi.

definition_en: Different from the one already mentioned or known.
example_en: Do you have any other ideas for the weekend trip plan?
example_uz: Dam olish kuni sayohat rejasi uchun boshqa fikrlaringiz bormi?

definition_en: Facts or details about a person, event, or situation.
example_en: You can find more information about this course on the website.
example_uz: Ushbu kurs haqida ko'proq ma'lumotni veb-saytdan topishingiz mumkin.

definition_en: Used to refer to two or more people or things previously mentioned.
example_en: They are going to the library to study for their exams.
example_uz: Ular imtihonlarga tayyorlanish uchun kutubxonaga ketishmoqda.

definition_en: A place where a building or event is located.
example_en: The company chose a perfect site for their new office building.
example_uz: Kompaniya o'zining yangi ofis binosi uchun mukammal joyni tanladi.

definition_en: Used to show that something is possible but not certain.
example_en: We may go to the mountains if the weather stays nice.
example_uz: Agar ob-havo yaxshi bo'lsa, biz tog'larga borishimiz mumkin.

definition_en: Used to ask for information about things or actions.
example_en: What is your name and where are you from?
example_uz: Ismingiz nima va qayerdansiz?

definition_en: Used to ask for a choice between a limited number of things.
example_en: Which shirt do you want to wear today?
example_uz: Bugun qaysi ko'ylakni kiyishni xohlaysiz?

definition_en: Belonging to or related to a group of people previously mentioned.
example_en: The students are happy with their exam results.
example_uz: Talabalar o'zlarining imtihon natijalaridan xursand.

definition_en: New information about events that happen in the world.
example_en: I watched the morning news on television yesterday.
example_uz: Kecha televizorda tonggi yangiliklarni ko'rdim.

definition_en: Moving away from the inside of a place or container.
example_en: It is a sunny day, let us go out for a walk.
example_uz: Havo quyoshli, keling, sayrga chiqamiz.

definition_en: Used to refer to one or some of a thing, no matter how much.
example_en: Do you have any questions about this lesson?
example_uz: Ushbu dars haqida biron savolingiz bormi?

definition_en: Nothing more than what is specified or described.
example_en: I only have five dollars in my wallet right now.
example_uz: Hozir hamyonimda bor-yo'g'i besh dollarim bor.

definition_en: Belonging to or connected with a male person.
example_en: He left his umbrella in the office by mistake.
example_uz: U soyabonini adashib ofisda qoldirib ketdi.

definition_en: At the time that something else happens.
example_en: I get happy when I see my friends at the park.
example_uz: Do'stlarimni parkda ko'rganimda xursand bo'laman.

definition_en: To call or write to someone to give or receive information.
example_en: Please contact us if you have any more questions about this.
example_uz: Agar bu haqda yana savollaringiz bo'lsa biz bilan bog'laning.

definition_en: The activity of making, buying, or selling goods or services for money.
example_en: She decided to start her own business after leaving university.
example_uz: U universitetni tugatgach o'z biznesini boshlashga qaror qildi.

definition_en: Used to ask about the name or identity of a person.
example_en: Do you know who is coming to the party tonight?
example_uz: Bugun oqshom partiga kim kelayotganini bilasizmi?

definition_en: The system of connected pages on the internet.
example_en: I found all the information I needed on the web today.
example_uz: Bugun menga kerak bo'lgan barcha ma'lumotni internetdan topdim.

definition_en: An opinion or way of thinking about a particular subject.
example_en: In my view, education is the most important thing for success.
example_uz: Mening fikrimcha, ta'lim muvaffaqiyat uchun eng muhim narsadir.

definition_en: Connected to or available through the internet.
example_en: Many students prefer to take online classes from their home.
example_uz: Ko'p talabalar uydan turib onlayn darslarda qatnashishni ma'qul ko'rishadi.

definition_en: Coming before all others in time or order.
example_en: It was my first time visiting a foreign country last year.
example_uz: O'tgan yili xorijiy davlatga birinchi marta tashrif buyurgan edim.

definition_en: The past participle form of the verb be, used to describe completed actions or states.
example_en: I have been to the city center many times this year.
example_uz: Men bu yil shahar markazida ko'p marta bo'lganman.

definition_en: A word used to talk about possible, imagined, or polite future actions.
example_en: I would visit you if I had more free time today.
example_uz: Agar bugun ko'proq vaqtim bo'lganda, siznikiga borardim.

definition_en: Used to ask about the way or condition of something or someone.
example_en: Can you explain how this machine works for us please?
example_uz: Iltimos, bu mashina qanday ishlashini bizga tushuntirib bera olasizmi?

definition_en: The plural past tense of the verb be, used with we, you, and they.
example_en: We were very happy when we heard the good news yesterday.
example_uz: Kecha xushxabarni eshitganimizda juda xursand edik.

definition_en: Useful work or help that a person or company provides to others.
example_en: The bank offers many useful financial services to its local customers.
example_uz: Bank o'z mahalliy mijozlariga ko'plab foydali moliyaviy xizmatlarni taklif etadi.

definition_en: An amount or number that is not specified, but is not zero.
example_en: I need some help to finish this difficult task on time.
example_uz: Ushbu qiyin vazifani o'z vaqtida tugatish uchun menga biroz yordam kerak.

definition_en: Plural of this, used to point to things near the speaker.
example_en: Are these keys yours, or did you find them on the table?
example_uz: Bu kalitlar siznikimi yoki ularni stoldan topib oldingizmi?

definition_en: To press a button on a computer mouse to select or open something.
example_en: You need to click the blue icon to start the program.
example_uz: Dasturni ishga tushirish uchun ko'k rangli belgini bosishingiz kerak.

definition_en: Belonging to a thing or animal.
example_en: The cat hurt its leg while jumping off the wall.
example_uz: Mushuk devordan sakrayotganda oyog'ini shikastlab oldi.

definition_en: Help or work done by someone for another person or organization.
example_en: The customer was very happy with the service at the hotel.
example_uz: Mijoz mehmonxonadagi xizmatdan juda mamnun bo'ldi.

definition_en: Used to compare two different things, people, or amounts.
example_en: My brother is much taller than I am.
example_uz: Akam mendan ancha baland bo'yli.

definition_en: A specific day of the month or year.
example_en: What is the date of your birthday celebration?
example_uz: Tug'ilgan kuningiz nishonlanadigan sana qaysi?

definition_en: The highest part or surface of something.
example_en: We climbed to the top of the mountain to see the view.
example_uz: Manzarani ko'rish uchun tog'ning cho'qqisiga chiqdik.

definition_en: The past form of the verb have.
example_en: I had a busy day at work yesterday.
example_uz: Kecha ishda juda band kunim bo'ldi.

definition_en: Simply or only.
example_en: I just want to relax and read a book.
example_uz: Men shunchaki dam olib kitob o'qimoqchiman.

definition_en: Finished or ended.
example_en: The movie is over so we should leave now.
example_uz: Kino tugadi, shuning uchun endi ketishimiz kerak.

definition_en: To express something clearly and formally in speech or writing.
example_en: The report will state the facts clearly for all the committee members.
example_uz: Hisobot barcha qo'mita a'zolari uchun faktlarni aniq bayon qiladi.

definition_en: Used to show movement to a position inside something.
example_en: She walked into the room and sat down on the comfortable chair.
example_uz: U xonaga kirdi va qulay stulga o'tirdi.

definition_en: A message sent from one computer to another using the internet.
example_en: I sent an email to my teacher about the next school project.
example_uz: Men o'qituvchimga keyingi maktab loyihasi haqida elektron xat yubordim.

definition_en: The number that comes after one and before three.
example_en: I have two sisters who are both older than me in age.
example_uz: Mening ikkita opam bor, ikkalasi ham mendan yoshi katta.

definition_en: The earth and all the people, places, and things on it.
example_en: There are many different countries all around the world to visit today.
example_uz: Bugun dunyo bo'ylab tashrif buyurish uchun ko'plab turli mamlakatlar mavjud.

definition_en: Coming immediately after the current person, thing, or time.
example_en: We will have our next English lesson on Monday morning at nine.
example_uz: Biz keyingi ingliz tili darsimizni dushanba kuni soat to'qqizda o'tamiz.

definition_en: Something that has been owned or operated by someone else before.
example_en: My brother bought a used car because it was much cheaper today.
example_uz: Akam ishlatilgan mashina sotib oldi, chunki u bugun ancha arzon edi.

definition_en: Coming after all others in time or order; final.
example_en: This is the last piece of cake, so please take it now.
example_uz: Bu tortning oxirgi bo'lagi, shuning uchun iltimos uni hozir oling.

definition_en: The greatest amount of something or the majority of a group.
example_en: Most people like to spend time with their families on weekends.
example_uz: Ko'pchilik dam olish kunlarini oilasi bilan o'tkazishni yoqtiradi.

definition_en: Things that are made or grown to be sold.
example_en: The store sells fresh local products every day of the week.
example_uz: Do'kon har hafta yangi mahalliy mahsulotlarni sotadi.

definition_en: Sounds arranged in a way that is pleasant or interesting to listen to.
example_en: I listen to relaxing music when I want to focus on work.
example_uz: Ishga diqqatimni qaratmoqchi bo'lganimda tinchlantiruvchi musiqa eshitaman.

definition_en: Used to refer to a group of people or things previously mentioned.
example_en: I saw my friends and invited them to have dinner with me.
example_uz: Do'stlarimni ko'rib qoldim va ularni kechki ovqatga taklif qildim.

definition_en: Used to say what is the right or best thing to do.
example_en: You should eat more vegetables if you want to be healthy.
example_uz: Sog'lom bo'lishni istasangiz, ko'proq sabzavot iste'mol qilishingiz kerak.

definition_en: Something that is made, grown, or created to be sold to people.
example_en: This new cleaning product is very effective for removing tough stains.
example_uz: Ushbu yangi tozalash vositasi qiyin dog'larni ketkazishda juda samarali.

definition_en: A set of related parts that work together to achieve a specific goal.
example_en: The school has a new system to track student attendance every morning.
example_uz: Maktabda har kuni ertalab o'quvchilar davomatini kuzatish uchun yangi tizim bor.

definition_en: To publish something on the internet for people to see.
example_en: I will post the photos from our trip on my social media.
example_uz: Sayohatimizdan olingan suratlarni ijtimoiy tarmoqlarimga joylayman.

definition_en: Belonging to or associated with a female person or animal.
example_en: She is reading a book and this is her favorite story.
example_uz: U kitob o'qiyapti va bu uning eng sevimli hikoyasi.

definition_en: To put something together with something else to increase the size or amount.
example_en: Please add a little more sugar to my hot coffee today.
example_uz: Iltimos, bugun issiq qahvamga biroz ko'proq shakar qo'shing.

definition_en: A symbol or word used to represent a specific amount or quantity.
example_en: Can you write down your phone number on this piece of paper?
example_uz: Telefon raqamingizni shu qog'ozga yozib bera olasizmi?

definition_en: Of the type already mentioned or to a high degree.
example_en: I have never seen such a beautiful garden in this city.
example_uz: Men bu shaharda hech qachon bunday go'zal bog'ni ko'rmaganman.

definition_en: A polite word used to ask for something or to make a request.
example_en: Could you please help me carry these heavy bags to the car?
example_uz: Iltimos, bu og'ir sumkalarni mashinagacha olib borishga yordam bera olasizmi?

definition_en: The legal right to control the use and distribution of an artistic work.
example_en: The author holds the copyright for all of her published books.
example_uz: Muallif o'zining barcha nashr etilgan kitoblari uchun mualliflik huquqiga ega.

definition_en: Following in time or at a later point than something else.
example_en: We usually go for a walk after we finish our dinner.
example_uz: Biz odatda kechki ovqatni tugatganimizdan so'ng sayrga chiqamiz.

definition_en: Of the highest quality or more excellent than all others.
example_en: This restaurant is widely known as the best place for lunch.
example_uz: Bu restoran tushlik qilish uchun eng yaxshi joy sifatida keng tanilgan.

definition_en: Computer programs and data that allow a computer to perform specific tasks.
example_en: You need to install the latest software to update your computer system.
example_uz: Kompyuter tizimini yangilash uchun eng so'nggi dasturiy ta'minotni o'rnatishingiz kerak.

definition_en: Used to describe something that happened after another event or at that time.
example_en: We went to the shop and then we had some lunch.
example_uz: Biz do'konga bordik va keyin tushlik qildik.

definition_en: A recording of moving images and sound that you can watch on a screen.
example_en: I watched a short video about wild animals on my phone today.
example_uz: Men bugun telefonimda yovvoyi hayvonlar haqida qisqa video tomosha qildim.

definition_en: In a very good or satisfactory way.
example_en: She speaks English very well because she practices every single day.
example_uz: U ingliz tilida juda yaxshi gapiradi, chunki u har kuni mashq qiladi.

definition_en: Used to ask about or talk about a place or position.
example_en: Can you tell me where the nearest train station is located?
example_uz: Menga eng yaqin poyezd bekati qayerda joylashganini ayta olasizmi?

definition_en: Connected to or shared by all people in a society or community.
example_en: The local library is a public place open to everyone in town.
example_uz: Mahalliy kutubxona shahardagi barcha uchun ochiq bo'lgan jamoat joyidir.

definition_en: Objects with pages containing writing or pictures that you can read.
example_en: She keeps all her school books on the wooden shelf.
example_uz: U barcha maktab kitoblarini yog'och tokchada saqlaydi.

definition_en: Having a large distance from the bottom to the top.
example_en: We climbed a very high mountain during our summer holiday.
example_uz: Biz yozgi ta'tilimiz davomida juda baland tog'ga chiqdik.

definition_en: Moving from one side of an opening or space to the other.
example_en: The bright sunlight came through the large glass window.
example_uz: Yorqin quyosh nuri katta shisha deraza orqali tushdi.

definition_en: Every single person or thing in a group, considered separately.
example_en: Each student must finish their homework before the next class.
example_uz: Har bir o'quvchi keyingi darsgacha uyga vazifasini tugatishi kerak.

definition_en: Connections between two things, or items on a website you can click.
example_en: There are many useful links on this educational website.
example_uz: Ushbu ta'lim veb-saytida juda ko'p foydali havolalar mavjud.

definition_en: Used to refer to a female person or animal previously mentioned.
example_en: My sister is a doctor and she works very hard.
example_uz: Singlim shifokor va u juda qattiq ishlaydi.

definition_en: A report that gives an opinion about a book, film, or product.
example_en: I read a very positive review of the new movie online.
example_uz: Men internetda yangi kino haqida juda ijobiy sharh o'qidim.

definition_en: Periods of twelve months, starting from January 1st.
example_en: They have lived in this small city for many years.
example_uz: Ular ushbu kichik shaharda ko'p yillar davomida yashashgan.

definition_en: The state of being alone and free from public attention or disturbance.
example_en: I value my privacy and do not like to share personal details.
example_uz: Men shaxsiy hayotim daxlsizligini qadrlayman va shaxsiy ma'lumotlarimni bo'lishishni yoqtirmayman.

definition_en: Individual things or objects that are part of a list or group.
example_en: There are many items on the shopping list to buy today.
example_uz: Bugun sotib olinadigan xaridlar ro'yxatida juda ko'p buyumlar bor.

definition_en: An organization that sells goods or services to make money.
example_en: She works for a large company that sells computer software globally.
example_uz: U butun dunyo bo'ylab kompyuter dasturlarini sotadigan yirik kompaniyada ishlaydi.

definition_en: A large number of people or things.
example_en: There are many students waiting for the bus in the street.
example_uz: Ko'chada avtobus kutayotgan ko'p talabalar bor.
